title: CLI: use cmd.Context() instead of registry.Context() or context.Background()
body:
Replace direct calls to context.Background() and registry.Context() in the CLI with use of a context.Background() carried down from the main cobra Command.

~cmd/podman/inspect.Inspect() will still call registry.Context() directly, as it's, in turn, called by the e2e tests.  And possibly external API consumers?~

The shutting down of the image and container engine objects before exiting now uses a one-off context with a timeout instead of context.Background().
